svg.text: sun's pass, then the update on every core: no frame
Sponza: gi_threads draws 3 frames during its update, 23.6 to 23.7 ms each against 18.60 steady; its first
frame with the new field ends 138.5 ms after the sun was set. gi stops 174.5 ms. Ten scenes: 2 to 7 frames,
each 1.25 to 1.36 times the steady frame (measurements/gi_threads).
